categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Has the Validation label and directly modifies block connection and transaction validation hot paths across consensus checks.
categories.rationale: The PR optimizes validation hot paths, yielding modest end-to-end performance gains. Benchmarks demonstrate microbenchmark speedups for duplicate input checks and a ~1% reduction in `reindex-chainstate` time (saving 2m27s across 4h12m).
